snippet.title: Vacation Cafe Simulator — Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a fresh look at Vacation Cafe Simulator ☕️

Build, customize, and run your own cozy seaside cafe — manage orders, upgrade your space, and create the perfect relaxing spot.

The game will be available on Steam on 20 August.

📌Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3196440/Vacation_Cafe_Simulator/
